match: How do I apply for admission
How can I apply to Commecs
How to get admission at Commecs
answer:
To apply for first-year admission at Commecs College:

1.  **Check eligibility:** at least 65% in SSC-I/O Level for the Science groups (Pre-Engineering, Pre-Medical, Computer Science) or 60% for Commerce.
2.  **Register online** at https://admissions.commecscollege.edu.pk/sign-in. Write your name and your father's name exactly as on your SSC/O Level marks sheet, and upload the SSC-I/O Level marks sheet, B-Form and passport-size photographs.
3.  **Pay the Rs. 1,000 registration fee** at least 2 days before the Commecs Admission Test (CAT).
4.  **Take the computer-based CAT** and attend the **interview**.

Provisional admission is given on merit, which is decided from your SSC-I result, the CAT and the interview. Recommendations or use of influence lead to disqualification, and any misstatement of information cancels admission. The next test date is currently listed as "to be announced" on the Instructions for Admission page.

match: How can I get a scholarship
answer:
Commecs offers three kinds of fee support. All of them apply to **tuition fee only**:

*   **Merit-based scholarship:** 100% tuition waiver for the top 3% of each discipline/group. Minimum SSC/equivalent is 88% (Karachi and other matric boards) or 85% (Cambridge, Edexcel, Aga Khan, Federal boards), or an A grade in BIEK first year, plus a scholarship interview.
*   **Need-based scholarship:** for families with total household income up to Rs. 275,000 per month. Students equal to 7% of the total strength get a 100% tuition freeship, and others are awarded according to their points. The Managing Committee decides.
*   **Sibling discount:** 25% off tuition fee when a brother or sister also studies at Commecs in the same year.

Merit scholarships are considered at the time of admission. For need-based scholarships, the application form and affidavit are on the Downloads page. Both scholarships continue only if results, attendance and discipline conditions are met.

match: How to get a merit scholarship
answer:
The **Merit Based Scholarship (2026-27)** is a 100% tuition-fee waiver for the top 3% of each discipline/group. To be considered you need:

*   **88%** or more in SSC/equivalent from Karachi and other matric boards, **85%** or more from Cambridge, Edexcel, Aga Khan or Federal boards, or an **A grade** or above in BIEK first year, and
*   a scholarship interview.

To keep it: minimum "B++" marks in term examinations and 90% attendance. Missing the criteria in the mid-term costs 25% of the scholarship, missing them again in the preliminary exam costs another 25%, and a disciplinary issue can cancel it fully. It covers tuition fee only.

match: What is the need based scholarship
How to get a need based scholarship
answer:
The **Need Based Scholarship (2026-27)** is for students facing financial hardship, awarded on a need-cum-merit basis with strict confidentiality.

*   **First year:** total household income from all sources up to Rs. 275,000 per month.
*   **Second year:** the same income limit, plus at least C++ in the first-year Prelim exam, 85% attendance and no discipline issue in first year.
*   **100% freeship:** students equal to 7% of the total strength who top the points table get their full tuition fee waived (including deserving orphans, wards of single mothers and divorced mothers not supported by the father). Others are awarded according to their points.

It is tied to results, attendance and discipline: 25% is deducted at each of two stages (mid-term and preliminary) if you miss a "B" grade and 90% attendance. It covers tuition fee only, and the Managing Committee has the final say.
